The '''Biravia system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Venaarian sector/Legends|Venaarian sector]], a part of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]<ref name="EAOC" /> and the [[Trans-Hydian/Legends|Trans-Hydian]] regions.<ref name="TEA" /> The system was the origin point of the group known as [[Biravian]]s.<ref name="Order 66" /><ref name="Planetnamia" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Biravia system was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], which placed the system in grid square O-7.<ref name="TEA" />
